architecture_principles: the unit of decision is an experiment, not a formulation
value of information is computed by a deterministic scientific tool, not by an additional language model
every registered hypothesis carries an explicit pre-result prediction rule and an explicit falsification condition
a measurement that cannot separate any registered hypothesis scores zero discrimination, and that is a scientific result rather than a defect
weight sensitivity is reported as decision stability, never as model confidence
ties in the deterministic layer are reported as ties; the tool must not manufacture a preference it does not have
held-out result data are structurally removed before any payload is assembled
the mechanism question and the Agent framework are separate contributions and are reported separately

candidate_space.rationale: V4 deliberately reuses the byte-identical V3 lattice. Continuous-space optimization and any new wet-lab work are out of scope, so that the measured change between V3 and V4 is the decision object and the VOI layer, not the search space.

architecture.canonical_flow: planner(intent + failure mode) -> evidence/tool layer (including the deterministic VOI tool) -> proposer -> skeptic -> robustness adjudicator -> judge -> freeze
architecture.claim_boundary: V4.0.0 selects an experiment from pre-result evidence under an outcome-blind runtime. Its adjudication tests whether a registered hypothesis survives contact with the completed measurement. It is not a contemporaneous pre-experimental record and does not claim that the historical decision used this ranking.
architecture.name: PUR_NEW_VOI_GUIDED_EXPERIMENT_SELECTION_AGENT_V4
non_goals: adding a language model to compute value of information
adding Agent roles beyond planner, tools, proposer, skeptic, robustness adjudicator, judge and freeze
turning the study into a pure AI benchmark
weakening or replacing the rheological mechanism result
architecture.purpose: Outcome-blind scientific decision Agent that selects the next formulation x measurement EXPERIMENT by transparent value of information, rather than selecting a formulation candidate alone.

stages.role: identify the physical failure mode and the scientific question that the next experiment must answer, then request the evidence needed to judge experiments rather than formulations

execute read-only scientific tools, including the paper-derived state-aware rheology tool, external evidence retrieval, and the deterministic VOI tool that scores every formulation x measurement experiment card
propose the experiment with the highest scientific information value, stating the hypotheses it separates and what each possible outcome would establish
attack the proposed experiment on hypothesis coverage, confounding, interpretability of the primary observable, and whether the stated falsification criterion can actually be met by the measurement
adjudicate whether the proposed experiment survives the reported VOI weight sensitivity and the skeptic's strongest objection
commit to one experiment card, or abstain, and state the acceptance and falsification criteria that will adjudicate it
programmatically validate and freeze the experiment card with timestamps, model identifiers and cryptographic hashes of every input

architecture.supersedes_nothing: V4 is an independent architecture. configs/agent_v3.json, prompts/agent_v3_*.txt, src/pur_new/agent_v3.py and every frozen V3 run record remain unchanged and are not reinterpreted by V4.

voi_tool.explicitly_not: distance to any held-out formulation. No target coordinate enters any component, weight or tie-break.
voi_tool.formula: VOI = w_hyp * hypothesis_discrimination + w_unc * uncertainty_reduction + w_dec * decision_relevance + w_int * measurement_interpretability - w_ext * extrapolation_risk - w_proc * process_state_risk
voi_tool.name: score_experiment_cards
voi_tool.not_a_posterior: The local design contains six audited realizations and two thermal-hold trajectories. That does not support a calibrated Bayesian expected-information computation, so no posterior probability is fabricated. Weight sensitivity is reported instead.

decision_stability_sent_to_model.metric_is_not: model confidence; posterior probability; calibrated expected information
decision_stability_sent_to_model.tie_interpretation: The deterministic VOI layer is indifferent among the tied top experiments: they share an identical component vector. Tie-breaking is therefore a genuine task left to the Agent, and any selection inside this set cannot have been read off the VOI ranking.
decision_stability_sent_to_model.voi_formula: VOI = w_hyp * hypothesis_discrimination + w_unc * uncertainty_reduction + w_dec * decision_relevance + w_int * measurement_interpretability - w_ext * extrapolation_risk - w_proc * process_state_risk. Every component is normalized to [0, 1] by construction. This is a transparent normalized score with reported weight sensitivity, not a Bayesian posterior.

evidence_policy.description: For prospective/blind Agent evaluation. The Agent may see original-system measurements and external analogue evidence, but not the target validation formulation identity, its wet-lab outcome, or any outcome-derived labels.

judge_normalized.acceptance_criterion: Accept acrylic-only superlinear drift suppression if the prespecified arithmetic mean SI_15_60 across at least two independent preparations is below 3.80%, which is below half of the 7.61% linear-dilution prediction for reactive mass fraction 0.8000.
judge_normalized.falsification_criterion: If mean SI_15_60 is below 3.80%, falsify H-CORE and H-DUAL because low drift occurred in an acrylic-only formulation with 0% minor tackifier. If mean SI_15_60 is at or above 7.61%, falsify H-RESIN. A mean from 3.80% through less than 7.61% falsifies none of the registered hypotheses cleanly.
judge_normalized.next_experiment_if_falsified: Run the Skeptic's matched M-HOLD-120 factorial set under one controlled process history: E2 reactive core, a tackifier-only arm, S1C49 acrylic-only, and S1C41 dual-axis. Use at least two independent preparations per arm, report repeat means and individual values, record eta_15, and verify modifier reactive functionality and NCO:OH before interpretation.
judge_normalized.primary_observable: Arithmetic mean across at least two independent preparations of SI_15_60 = 100 × (eta_60 - eta_15) / eta_15, measured at 120 C; individual-repeat SI_15_60 values and eta_15 values must also be reported.
judge_normalized.rationale: S1C49::M-HOLD-120 directly measures the declared failure mode and places H-DUAL at its registered falsification boundary. Its 3.80% and 7.61% decision boundaries are separated by more than the 2.00-percentage-point measurement threshold. The experiment remains a discriminating probe rather than a molecular-mechanism test, and H-CORE versus H-DUAL remains entangled for a high-drift outcome.
judge_normalized.stage_disagreements_resolved: I followed the Skeptic and Robustness Adjudicator rather than the Proposer. The Proposer's S1C41 dual-axis hold is directly relevant and top-ranked, but it cannot satisfy H-DUAL's defining acrylic-only falsification condition and contradicts the planner's acrylic-only scientific question. S1C49 retains the same 20% total modifier burden and reactive mass fraction 0.8000 while removing minor tackifier, so the hold can distinguish acrylic-only suppression from a tackifier-required formulation-level account. This scientific boundary condition was not adequately encoded in the deterministic VOI score.

uncertainty_decomposition.evidence_coverage_uncertainty: The 20% acrylic-only level is within the supplied supported acrylic region, but external analogues establish only a coarse formulation region and not a local outcome. Modifier functionality and effective stoichiometry remain unverified.
uncertainty_decomposition.extrapolation_uncertainty: The measurement itself stays within the observed 120 C and 15-60 min window, but the 7.61% H-CORE prediction extrapolates the E1 drift coefficient to an E2-core candidate because no E2-core hold trajectory is available.
uncertainty_decomposition.measurement_uncertainty: The registered matched-window discrimination threshold is 2.00 percentage points. At least two independent repeats are required, and the arithmetic repeat mean is frozen as the decision statistic; discordant individual repeats remain reportable evidence of instability.
uncertainty_decomposition.realization_state_uncertainty: M-HOLD-120 does not control preparation state, while E2 showed a 3.57-fold viscosity-scale spread at 120 C. Controlled and fully recorded preparation histories plus eta_15 are required so relative drift can be interpreted without silently treating absolute viscosity level as fixed.

planner.failure_mode: Formulation-dependent viscosity growth during prolonged isothermal melt residence at 120 °C.
planner.failure_mode_evidence: The original E5 thermal-hold run increased by 51.54% from 15 to 60 min at 120 °C, compared with 9.51% for E1 over the same matched window.
planner.least_resolved_justification: Local temperature response is covered by six-point 80–130 °C sweeps, and realized-level variability is quantified for E2 across three nominal runs. In contrast, isothermal behavior is represented only by single 120 °C hold trajectories for E1 and E5, with no measured hold trajectory for the E2 reactive-core anchor or any candidate composition.
measurement_requirements: Measure viscosity during a 120 °C isothermal hold at 15, 30, 45, and 60 min and report SI_15_60 = (eta_60 - eta_15) / eta_15 as a percentage.
Run at least two independent preparations under controlled and fully recorded process histories.
Calculate the frozen H-CORE prediction E1_drift × phi_r from the candidate's reactive mass fraction and compare the measured drift directly with that prediction.
Use the registered 2 percentage-point matched-window discrimination threshold; treat closer predictions as experimentally unresolved.

Test the H-RESIN criterion that drift is below half the linear-dilution prediction, while an acrylic-only composition provides the required check of the H-DUAL claim that a nonzero minor tackifier fraction is necessary for low drift.
Keep the primary inference within the measured 120 °C and 15–60 min window, preserve viscosity source units, and do not infer a molecular reaction pathway from rheology alone.
Record the realized viscosity level at the start of the matched window so that drift suppression is not conflated with an uncontrolled preparation-state displacement.
planner.scientific_question: For an acrylic-only modification of the E2 reactive core, is the measured 120 °C viscosity drift consistent with the H-CORE linear-dilution prediction, or is it suppressed to below half that prediction as expected under H-RESIN? Observing low drift without a minor tackifier would also falsify the tackifier-required prediction of H-DUAL.

outcome_interpretation.if_acceptance_criterion_met: If SI_15_60 remains below 3.80% across at least two repeats, the drift is below half the 7.61% linear-dilution prediction. This falsifies H-CORE and supports superlinear resin suppression. It is also consistent with H-DUAL because a minor tackifier is present, so it does not distinguish H-RESIN from H-DUAL.
outcome_interpretation.if_falsification_criterion_met: If SI_15_60 is at or above 7.61%, H-RESIN is falsified and the result supports H-CORE's linear-dilution account over the shared low-drift prediction. Because this dual-axis composition does not meet H-DUAL's registered acrylic-only falsification condition, H-DUAL is not independently falsified by this card.
outcome_interpretation.if_intermediate: A drift above 3.80% but below 7.61%, or inconsistent repeat outcomes, would indicate partial or process-sensitive suppression without meeting either registered decision boundary. It would not cleanly accept H-RESIN or H-CORE and would still leave H-RESIN versus H-DUAL unresolved.

proposer.primary_observable: SI_15_60 = (eta_60 - eta_15) / eta_15, percent, measured directly during the 120 C hold

ranked_alternatives.why_lower_value: It has identical measured-observable quality, support status, and pairwise discrimination, but uses 17.5% rather than 15% acrylic and therefore makes a larger formulation perturbation without adding information.
The 20% acrylic level has strong directly commensurate external analogue support, but it separates exactly the same two hypothesis pairs and requires a larger modifier burden than S1C41.
It remains inside the supported region but increases acrylic loading to 22.5% without improving directness, uncertainty reduction, or hypothesis discrimination.
The 25% acrylic level is externally supported but is the largest perturbation among the tied cards and provides no additional hypothesis separation.

proposer.reasoning: This experiment directly measures the declared failure mode in the matched 120 C, 15-60 min window with at least two independent preparations, rather than inferring drift through a regression or state-transfer model. Its composition is inside both externally supported modifier regions and its outcome separates H-CORE from each low-drift prediction. The important limitation is explicit: because both modifier axes are active, H-RESIN and H-DUAL make the same low-drift prediction and cannot be separated. Preparation-state risk remains moderate, so process history and the 15 min realized viscosity level must be recorded.
proposer.tie_break_justification: All five tied cards have identical VOI components, directly measure the least-resolved isothermal-time coordinate, and lie inside the supported 15-25% acrylic and 4.8-6.4% minor-tackifier regions. S1C41 uses the smallest total modifier burden: 15% acrylic-like modifier plus 5% minor tackifier. The 5% tackifier level lies in the repeatedly documented minor-resin cluster, and 15% acrylic lies within the conservative initial test band, although its literature denominator is only directional. Under the stated minimum-sufficient-intervention policy, this is the smallest supported departure from the characterized E2 core without sacrificing any hypothesis discrimination.

robustness_adjudication.change_from_proposal: Replace the dual-axis S1C41 hold with the corresponding 20% acrylic-only, 0% minor-tackifier arm S1C49 using M-HOLD-120. This preserves the total modifier burden and reactive mass fraction of 0.8000 while placing H-DUAL at its registered falsification boundary. If resources permit, run it as part of the Skeptic's matched factorial set with E2-core, tackifier-only, and S1C41 dual-axis controls.
residual_decision_risk: The E2 reactive core has no measured 120 C hold trajectory, so an E1-derived linear-dilution baseline may not represent the E2-core drift coefficient.
A single acrylic-only arm cannot independently estimate acrylic, tackifier, dilution, and interaction effects as cleanly as the recommended matched factorial set.
M-HOLD-120 does not control process state, and E2 has shown large between-preparation viscosity-scale variation; process history and the 15 min realized viscosity level must be recorded.
The protocol does not prespecify whether decision thresholds apply to every repeat, the repeat mean, or an uncertainty interval, creating ambiguity for borderline or discordant repeats.
Modifier reactive functionality and the resulting NCO:OH ratio require verification before attributing drift changes to modifier-axis effects rather than altered stoichiometry.
Any inference must remain formulation-level and limited to the measured 120 C, 15-60 min window; rheology alone cannot establish a molecular encounter-frequency mechanism.
robustness_adjudication.skeptic_objection_reasoning: S1C41 directly measures thermal-hold drift and can separate the registered numerical H-CORE and H-RESIN thresholds, but it contains both 15% acrylic-like modifier and 5% minor tackifier. It therefore cannot produce the acrylic-only observation required to falsify H-DUAL and leaves H-RESIN versus H-DUAL entangled. This is not merely an interpretation caveat because the planner's scientific question explicitly asks about an acrylic-only modification. The entire tied top set has the same defect: all five experiments are dual-axis formulations with identical scored discrimination. An acrylic-only arm at the same total 20% modifier burden and reactive mass fraction of 0.8000 as S1C41 better tests whether tackifier presence is required. The missing E2-core hold trajectory remains an important baseline limitation and ideally requires a matched E2 control, but it does not justify selecting another member of the dual-axis tie.
robustness_adjudication.weight_sensitivity_assessment: The tied top set is unchanged in all 25 reported one-term perturbation scenarios: each weight was scaled from 0.5 to 1.5, no flipped scenarios occurred, and every recommendation_flip_boundary reports survival across the entire sweep. Thus no tested perturbation makes S1C41 cease to be top ranked. The base margin to the first strictly lower experiment is only 0.004583, but the reported sweep does not identify a defensible reweighting within its tested range that changes the top set. The adjudicated change is therefore based on a scientifically important design feature not adequately encoded by the score—testing H-DUAL at its acrylic-only falsification boundary—not on weight sensitivity.

skeptic.falsification_criterion_assessment: M-HOLD-120 directly measures SI_15_60, so it can produce SI_15_60 at or above 7.61% and thereby meet the stated H-RESIN falsification criterion, or below 3.80% and meet the stated H-CORE criterion. Their 3.804-percentage-point separation exceeds the declared 2.00-point resolution. The protocol cannot, however, meet H-DUAL's registered falsification condition because S1C41 contains 5.0% minor tackifier; classification of borderline repeat results also needs a prespecified aggregation rule.

objections.consequence_if_ignored: The experiment could be presented as adjudicating whether tackifier is required even though every tested sample contains tackifier; H-DUAL would remain untested at its defining boundary.
objections.objection: The planner's scientific_question specifies an "acrylic-only modification," and H-DUAL is falsified only if an acrylic-only composition reaches low drift without minor tackifier. Proposed candidate S1C41 instead contains 15.0% AC1920 and 5.0% TK100. It therefore cannot test the defining tackifier-required claim of H-DUAL. The proposer correctly declares H-RESIN versus H-DUAL unresolved, but its additional claim that H-CORE versus H-DUAL is separated applies only to their assigned numerical predictions, not to H-DUAL's registered acrylic-only falsification condition. The H-CORE prediction of 7.608% and the assigned low-drift prediction of 3.804% differ by 3.804 percentage points, which does exceed the declared 2.00-point resolution.

objections.consequence_if_ignored: Deviation from 7.61% could be attributed to resin suppression when it may instead reflect the unmeasured E2-core drift coefficient, modifier-specific effects, modifier interaction, or altered effective stoichiometry.
objections.objection: S1C41 simultaneously introduces 15.0% acrylic-like modifier, 5.0% minor tackifier-like modifier, and reduces the reactive mass fraction to 0.8000. A low SI_15_60 therefore cannot be attributed separately to acrylic action, tackifier action, their interaction, or dilution. In particular, the experiment cannot distinguish H-RESIN's general resin-associated superlinear suppression from H-DUAL's tackifier-required suppression. The proposer admits that pairwise entanglement, but the protocol also lacks an E2-core hold control: the 7.61% H-CORE baseline is calculated from E1_drift = 9.51% even though the candidate preserves the E2 reactive core, for which the payload explicitly says no hold trajectory exists.

objections.consequence_if_ignored: The measured quantity remains direct, but borderline or discordant repeats could be classified inconsistently after observation.
objections.objection: The primary observable itself survives this attack: SI_15_60 is calculated directly from measured eta_15 and eta_60 at 120 C and requires no regression, extrapolation, or imputation. However, the protocol states only "at least two independent repeats" and does not define whether thresholds apply to each repeat, the repeat mean, or a confidence interval. This matters for outcomes near 3.80% or 7.61%, especially given the reported E2 realization variability and the measurement card's statement that it does not control process state.

objections.consequence_if_ignored: The card can falsify the registered numerical H-RESIN or H-CORE predictions, but it cannot produce the result needed to falsify H-DUAL.
objections.objection: The numerical H-RESIN criterion is practically attainable because the protocol can directly observe SI_15_60 at or above 7.61%; likewise, values below 3.80% can satisfy the stated H-CORE criterion, and the 3.804-point prediction gap exceeds the 2.00-point resolution. In contrast, the scientific_question's proposed H-DUAL falsification—low drift without minor tackifier—is impossible in S1C41 because TK100 is fixed at 5.0%. The proposal acknowledges this in outcome_interpretation but nevertheless frames the broader question around an acrylic-only test.

objections.consequence_if_ignored: A rheological drift result could be overstated as evidence for a specific molecular or encounter-frequency mechanism rather than evidence only for formulation-level suppression.
objections.objection: No direct use of an unmeasured target hold result is evident in the supplied payload, and the proposal explicitly limits inference to the measured 120 C, 15-60 min window. Scope must remain phenomenological: a low drift can support superlinear suppression relative to the frozen baseline, but rheology alone cannot establish H-RESIN's stated causal language about reduced encounter frequency of reaction-capable species. The payload itself says no molecular pathway should be inferred.

skeptic.recommended_change: Replace the single dual-axis card with a matched factorial hold set containing: the E2 reactive core with no modifier, an acrylic-only arm, a tackifier-only arm, and the 15% acrylic plus 5% tackifier dual-axis arm. Include an acrylic-only composition with the same total 20% modifier burden and reactive mass fraction 0.8000 as S1C41 to separate tackifier presence from dilution. Run M-HOLD-120 on all arms with the same controlled process history, verify modifier reactive functionality and recalculate NCO:OH if necessary, use at least two independent preparations per arm, and prespecify whether thresholds apply per repeat or to a repeat mean with uncertainty.
skeptic.strongest_objection: The experiment uses a dual-axis S1C41 formulation while the stated scientific question and H-DUAL falsification condition require an acrylic-only composition. Combined with use of E1 drift to predict an E2-core candidate despite having no E2 hold trajectory, this prevents clean attribution of any departure from 7.61% to the proposed modifier mechanism.

claim_boundaries: The shared-shape/state-shift structure is established only within the measured local chemistry family.
The apparent E_eta descriptor is rheological, not a chemical reaction activation energy.
The E1/E5 hold contrast does not identify a unique molecular mechanism.
The phosphoric-acid-labelled E1 +P curve is not used in the chemistry-audited primary state model.
No validation-formulation identity or outcome is used by this tool.
design_rules: Represent a candidate as formulation plus process/realization state, not composition alone.

Use one state-specific anchor measurement to locate a new realization or nearby local formulation on the transferable thermal-response shape when it remains inside the supported local chemistry family.
Treat static viscosity, temperature response and thermal-hold stability as separate decision variables.
When the failure mode is hot-hold drift, choose an experiment and measurement window that directly test drift rather than only matching one nominal viscosity value.
Use external resin/tackifier evidence to define chemically plausible directions, but do not convert analogue proximity into a predicted local outcome.

one_point_state_calibration.interpretation: Within the tested local chemistry family, one state-specific viscosity anchor can locate a previously held-out nominal formulation on the shared thermal-response shape to roughly 6-10% pooled multiplicative error.
one_point_state_calibration.validation_scheme: leave one nominal formulation out; fit shared shape on the remaining formulations; use one anchor from the held formulation

state_shift_master_curve.interpretation: Within the chemistry-audited local family, a realization-specific viscosity-scale intercept plus a shared quadratic inverse-temperature response closes the data far better than a formulation-level intercept using the same thermal basis.

temporal_stability_coordinate.interpretation: Original E1 and E5 hold trajectories show that thermal-hold viscosity drift is strongly formulation dependent and should be treated separately from static viscosity.

thermal_coordinate.interpretation: The apparent temperature-sensitivity descriptor remains comparatively concentrated after chemistry auditing; it is a rheological descriptor, not a molecular reaction activation energy.

experiment_design_implications.hold_window: For the current local study, 120 C and the common 15-60 min window directly interrogate the observed instability while matching the available validation window.
experiment_design_implications.selection_target: Select a formulation-process point that is informative about the observed instability and state uncertainty, not merely the closest static-viscosity value.
experiment_design_implications.state_anchor: A single in-range anchor can be used for efficient local curve calibration; 120 C is operationally attractive because it is also the hold-stability test temperature.

provenance_audit.reason: The source record is phosphoric-acid-labelled and its additive identity/amount is not represented in formulations.csv; it is retained as sensitivity-only until chemistry is reconciled.

result.source_scope: original pre-validation local measurements with chemistry-comparability audit

tool_trace.reason: The pre-result E2-core candidate structure and independent acrylic/tackifier axes are needed to identify an admissible acrylic-only uncertainty probe without treating the lattice as a discovered optimum.

evidence: PAT_US20160215185A1: repeated acrylic tackifying resin examples at approximately 19-20% of total formulation
PAT_US6465104B1 Example 10: 25 wt% low-OH acrylic copolymer with direct 121 C viscosity-stability data
PAPER_CN_ADHESIVES_2025_34_09_54: reports a 15% preferred acrylic-resin addition level, retained as directional lower-bound evidence until its fraction denominator is reverified
acrylic_like_modifier_pct_total.interpretation: 20 and 25% are directly commensurate coarse anchors in the current curated record. The 15% grid level is retained as a lower-bound design point, but the literature denominator for the reported 15% addition level is not treated as an exact total-formulation anchor until reverified.

evidence: PAT_US5932680A: examples around 4.8-6.4% tackifying/hydrocarbon resin and preferred resin range 3-10 wt%
PAT_US20070155859A1: tackifiers/rheology-control agents typically used below about 10 wt%
minor_tackifier_like_modifier_pct_total.interpretation: 5% represents the repeatedly documented minor-resin region and 10% is a conservative coarse upper level.

result.claim_boundary: External examples are analogues. They support candidate-family and coarse-region hypotheses, not an exact optimum for AC1920/TK100 and not a proven local molecular mechanism. The current reconstruction uses only pre-result evidence at runtime; the exact validation coordinates and outcome are excluded from candidate construction, ranking and tie-breaking.

decision_policy.claim_boundary: This policy can recover an evidence-supported formulation neighborhood, but it is not a predictor of the exact wet-lab optimum.

acrylic_like.basis: 15% directional lower-region evidence plus directly commensurate ~19-20% examples; 25% remains directly supported but is a larger perturbation.

minor_tackifier_like.basis: Curated PUR examples repeatedly place tackifying/hydrocarbon resin near 5%, with broader guidance below about 10%.

experiment_intents.causal_isolation: Use when the primary objective is attribution of one formulation axis. Prefer a single active modifier axis only in this mode.
experiment_intents.performance_mitigation: Use when a measured failure mode is already established and the next experiment is intended to reduce that failure. Independently supported multi-modifier interventions are admissible.
experiment_intents.uncertainty_resolution: Use when missing process, stoichiometric or evidence information prevents an interpretable performance test.

decision_policy.purpose: Select an experimentally informative intervention from pre-result evidence without treating a literature composition as the hidden optimum.
ranking_rules: Exact distance to an external analogue anchor is audit metadata, not a primary optimization objective.
Candidates in the same evidence-support class are not rewarded merely for being numerically closer to a literature percentage.
For performance mitigation, two modifier axes may be combined when each is independently supported and the combination stays inside bounded evidence regions.

Among candidates with comparable evidence coverage and interpretability, prefer the smallest sufficient total modifier burden and the smallest justified departure from the characterized local chemistry.
A single-variable design is preferred only when causal attribution is the stated experiment intent; it is not a universal default.
Held-out validation coordinates and outcomes must never enter candidate construction, ranking or tie-breaking.

historical_status.interpretation: The prospective historical claim attaches to the Agent recommendation itself. The current coarse grid and fine-refinement software are later reproducible operationalizations of the evidence-constrained region and are not represented as the original contemporaneous freeze algorithm unless older provenance is recovered.

local_reactive_core_anchor.reason: E2 is the geometric centre of the original five-point local design: 50/50 PPG2000/PDP-70 and NCO:OH=1.80, centered between E1/E3 stoichiometric perturbations and E4/E5 composition perturbations.
local_reactive_core_anchor.stoichiometry_note: The E2 NCO:OH=1.80 label applies to the original reactive core. If a modifier contributes reactive OH or another NCO-reactive group, true stoichiometry must be recalculated from verified material specifications.

stability_hypotheses.H1_formulation_family: Partial replacement of the reactive-only formulation by an acrylic-like and/or minor tackifier-like resin can reduce hot-hold viscosity drift under matched process conditions.
stability_hypotheses.H2_functionality: At comparable acrylic loading, lower effective reactive-group density or lower-OH acrylic chemistry is expected to be more favorable for hot-hold viscosity stability than more highly reactive acrylic chemistry.
stability_hypotheses.H3_region: A useful candidate region is expected within the externally supported coarse space spanned by 15-25% acrylic-like modifier and 0-10% minor tackifier-like modifier, while preserving the relative E2 reactive-core proportions.

voi_sent_to_model.formula: VOI = w_hyp * hypothesis_discrimination + w_unc * uncertainty_reduction + w_dec * decision_relevance + w_int * measurement_interpretability - w_ext * extrapolation_risk - w_proc * process_state_risk. Every component is normalized to [0, 1] by construction. This is a transparent normalized score with reported weight sensitivity, not a Bayesian posterior.
voi_sent_to_model.tie_note: These experiments share an identical component vector. The deterministic tool is indifferent among them. Any choice within this set must be justified scientifically.

top_cards.acceptance_criterion: Matched 15-60 min drift at 120 C stays below 3.80% across at least two repeats, i.e. below half the linear-dilution prediction of 7.61% implied by a reactive mass fraction of 0.8000. This accepts H-RESIN over H-CORE.
top_cards.falsification_criterion: H-RESIN is falsified if matched 15-60 min drift is at or above the linear-dilution prediction of 7.61%. H-CORE is falsified if drift falls below 3.80%, a separation larger than the 2.00% resolution threshold. This composition carries both axes, so it cannot separate H-RESIN from H-DUAL; an acrylic-only hold is the follow-up required for that.
